meta.name: Send weekly Bitcoin DCA signals from Coinbase Exchange to Telegram

name: Weekly Bitcoin DCA signal (200-day MA) from Coinbase to Telegram

parameters.content:
## 📊 Weekly Bitcoin DCA signal (MA200) → Telegram

Every Monday at 9:00, this workflow reads 300 daily candles from the **public** Coinbase Exchange API (no key), computes the 200-day moving average and sends you the suggested DCA amount on Telegram:
- price **above** MA200 → base amount × 1.5
- price **below** MA200 → base amount × 0.5 (0 = pause)

### Setup
1. Create a Telegram bot with @BotFather and add a **Telegram API** credential to the Telegram node.
2. In **Configuration**, set `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID`, `PRODUCT_ID` (BTC-EUR, ETH-EUR, BTC-USD…), `DCA_AMOUNT_EUR` (base amount, any quote currency), `MA_DAYS` and both multipliers.
3. Execute once to test, then activate.

No order is placed and no account access is needed. Not financial advice.

## ⚡ Going further

Full protocol with real numbers (17 live orders, 1.2% taker fees, a DCA that silently stopped): https://utikcoin.com/article/dca-automatise-coinbase-protocole

French README and source: https://github.com/HATEM6584/n8n-dca-signal-mm200
